a: Discovery reduces risk by learning before building large features.
Experiments test hypotheses with measurable outcomes.
Activation is when a new user reaches the first meaningful success.
Engagement measures how actively users interact over time.
Monetization is how the product captures value.
Pricing should reflect value, willingness to pay, and costs.
Interview for problems and behaviors, not feature wishlists only.
RICE scores Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort.
Balance shipping features with paying down tech debt.
Launch checklists cover monitoring, rollback, support, and docs.
